subject.title: fix(feishu): cancel agent runs when source messages are recalled

question: Should Feishu recalls abort every active single-agent and broadcast dispatch bound to the recalled source message within the receiving gateway process?
rationale: The patch is technically sound and uses established contracts, but the intentional broadcast fanout and process-local deployment boundary are runtime semantics requiring owner acceptance.

options.title: Land scoped Feishu cancellation
options.body: Ship the tested plugin-local behavior now and leave shared cross-channel or multi-process semantics to the canonical issue.

options.title: Wait for shared lifecycle design
options.body: Pause until maintainers define a common recall contract across channels and gateway processes.

recommendation.title: Land scoped Feishu cancellation
recommendation.body: Ship the tested plugin-local behavior now and leave shared cross-channel or multi-process semantics to the canonical issue.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history directly connects this person to the Feishu dispatch, monitor, and typing paths defining the cancellation lifecycle.
